text:
jamal: Heads-up — offer for Principal Data Engineer (R. Singh). Candidate asking $275k base; our band top is $225k. Counter offer expires Tue. Need comp-exception routing and expedited sign-off. :clock3:
mira: Strong match for vector-store + latency work. Target start May 4 but can be flexible a week.
jamal: Proposed package:
base: $275,000
sign-on: $40,000 (suggest split 50/50)
equity: 0.5% (4y, 1y cliff)
relocation: none
start: 2026-05-04 (flex +/- 7 days)

chris: Quick calc: band top $225k -> delta $50k = 22% above band. I can approve up to 10% above band; >10% needs VP People. Please include short justification and any candidate-provided competing offer details.
mira: Justification bullets (pasteable):
- 8+ years infra + vector/embedding production experience; shipped low-latency retrieval systems.
- Directly unblocks rollout of vector-store caching in Q2.
- Market comps show similar roles 15-25% above our band.
- Candidate has a written competing offer expiring 2026-04-14.
jamal: Submitted approval request AR-2026-02501 with justification. Marked expedite.
hr-bot: Approval request AR-2026-02501 created. Routing: chris -> sophia. Reason: MARKET_COMPETITOR. Expedited requested. ETA 48h.
chris: Pushing prelim approval to signal movement (approve up to 10% now). If VP signs for full $275k I'll finalize. Recommend sign-on paid 50% at start, 50% at 6mo with 6mo clawback.
sophia (VP People): Reviewed packet and market evidence. Approve one-time market exception to base=$275,000. Conditions: tag EXC_MARKET_2026_04, 12-month expiration, sign-on 6mo pro-rata clawback, record rationale in comp system.
chris: Noted. I'll apply EXC_MARKET_2026_04 in CompTool and open FIN ticket for sign-on schedule.
lucy: People-ops note: please cc people-ops@redwood on the offer email, use the offers template including exception language, and set tentative start to 2026-05-04.
jamal: Offer sent at 10:12 PT with exception block. Candidate accepted verbally within an hour and requested official signed offer.
hr-bot: Offer status updated: SENT -> ACCEPTED_VERBAL. Offer AR-2026-02501 updated.
jamal: Uploading signed doc once returned. Will close requisition after paperwork.
lucy: Thanks team — nice coordination and quick turnaround. :tada:
